content.comment_body: Hello, I've been trying to switch the language in [company_name] [product_name] [version_no] from English to Dutch. I followed all the steps in the instructions provided at [url], but when I get to steps 10 and 11, the Dutch language option doesn't appear. Am I missing something, or is there an issue with the process? Kind regards, [user_name]

You need to download two files from [company_name] Netherlands via their website: - Language.nl_NL.properties - Help_nl_NL.jar After downloading, move these files to the correct folders: - Place 'Language.nl_NL.properties' in 'C:\programs\[company_name]\[product_name]_[version_no]'. - Place 'Help_nl_NL.jar' in 'C:\programs\[company_name]\[product_name]_[version_no]\help'.

Hello [user_name], thanks for your reply. I tried this before posting my issue. Even after adding these files to the folders, the Dutch language option doesn't show in the menu (as seen in the attachment). Removing all languages except Dutch and English still only shows English. If anyone has encountered and fixed this, please let me know. Thanks.
I followed the same process: downloaded both files and placed them in the respective folders, and it worked without issues. What operating system are you using?
I'm using Windows 7 Professional 64-bit. It's surprising that it's not working, considering I've never had problems with [product_name] before.
I also used Windows 7 Pro 64-bit and didn't face any issues. I suggest submitting a support request.

There seems to be a minor typo in the filename. In 'Language.nl_NL.properties', the period after 'Language' should be changed to an underscore, so it reads 'Language_nl_NL.properties'. I had the same problem, and changing the filename resolved it.
That's correct. I changed it automatically when copying the file to the folder, which is why I didn't think further about the issue.
Perfect! The issue is resolved. Thanks, everyone!
If you also want to see 'Nederlands' instead of 'language.nl_NL' in the selection menu, there's a way to achieve this (see attachment).

analysis.insight_summary: Users face problems adding Dutch language support to [product_name] [version_no] even when following official instructions. The primary challenge is a filename typo in the language properties file, which prevents the Dutch option from appearing. Changing the filename as suggested solves the issue, highlighting that small manual steps in the localization process can affect the user experience.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to add and select Dutch as a language in [product_name] [version_no] by following official instructions and placing the provided files into the correct directories.
